It's the route you take to the  Playoffs and then, hopefully, the  Super Bowl.   The Packers are supposed to have  an easier schedule this season, based  on last year’s record, but don’t tell that  to Coach Bart Starr, who explains it  this way:   “People who get trapped into that  kind of thinking pay the price later.”   The Packers meet playoff teams in  three of their first four games and then  play four of their last five games on the  road. Starr feels “it’s a little  disadvantage to be playing that many  games on the road at the end.”.
